svg.title: Thornwood decorative initial B
svg.desc: Modified Morris Initialen artwork; Floriated woodcut letters with sharp medieval silhouettes and original lobed thorn leaves, cut veins, rosettes, branch spirals and double keylines. Transparent currentColor paths. Modified-work details: metadata.json. LPPL 1.3c or later. Complete original collection: https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/initials.zip.
